# Vendored front-end code

Butler has no Node/npm: third-party front-end code is copied here and bundled
by esbuild.

| File | What | Version | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `topbar.js` | progress bar of live navigation | 3.0.0 | https://github.com/buunguyen/topbar |
| `heroicons.js` | Tailwind plugin for the Heroicons | n/a | generated by Phoenix |
| `swagger-ui-bundle.js`, `swagger-ui.css` | Swagger UI (self-contained bundle) for `/swaggerui` | **5.34.0** | https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@5.34.0/ (npm `swagger-ui-dist`) |
| `LICENSE-swagger-ui` | Apache-2.0 license of Swagger UI | 5.34.0 | same package |

`assets/js/swagger.js` imports the two Swagger UI files; esbuild writes
`priv/static/assets/js/swagger.js` and `swagger.css` (the page loads nothing
from a CDN).

## Updating Swagger UI

1. Pick a release on https://www.npmjs.com/package/swagger-ui-dist.
2. Download the files, in `assets/vendor`:

   ```sh
   V=5.34.0   # the new version
   curl -fLO https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@$V/swagger-ui-bundle.js
   curl -fLO https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@$V/swagger-ui.css
   curl -fL -o LICENSE-swagger-ui https://unpkg.com/swagger-ui-dist@$V/LICENSE
   ```

3. Update the version in this file, run `mix assets.build` and check
   `/swaggerui` in a browser (Authorize, Try it out).

Do not edit the vendored files by hand.
